Chilling Reign

Released June 18, 2021 · 233 cards

Expanded

Chilling Reign is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on June 18, 2021. Its main set has 198 cards, plus 35 secret rares numbered beyond the set (233 in total). It includes 168 Pokémon, 59 Trainer and 6 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

77 illustrators worked on Chilling Reign. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (15), Mitsuhiro Arita (7), Sanosuke Sakuma (7), Ken Sugimori (6), kirisAki (6), Ryuta Fuse (6), Megumi Mizutani (5), Naoki Saito (5).
